title: Transport-neutral MCP server builder
objective: Establish the provider-neutral MCP server foundation without changing runtime authority: extract one authoritative server and tool registration source of truth, keep the v0.1 tool catalog and schemas byte-compatible, ensure transport adapters cannot create independent authority, and add transport contract tests proving identical schemas and behavior across the in-process builder and stdio transport.

include: one authoritative MCP server and tool registration source under apps/cotra-mcp/src/server.ts with safe result projection under apps/cotra-mcp/src/result.ts
refactored stdio transport adapter and entrypoint that reuse the authoritative builder without independent tool registration
skeleton transport adapter structure for loopback_http and relay_device that reuses the same builder and kernel contract without adding new authority
transport identity context plumbing for transport_kind and provider_kind as request metadata, never as caller-controlled tool fields
transport contract tests proving identical tool names, schemas, annotations, and result projection across in-process builder and stdio child process
preserved v0.1 behavior including the canonical 20-tool surface test and existing kernel IPC contract
exclude: any new MCP tool, tool schema change, capability widening, approval change, or authority change
loopback HTTP listener implementation beyond skeleton structure (reserved for SG-000050)
relay device transport implementation beyond skeleton structure (reserved for COTRA-P15)
any P15 remote relay, OAuth, device uplink, or public edge code
any P16 tool-surface widening, executable registry, filesystem, browser, desktop, clipboard, or network exposure change
any provider submission, directory publication, or availability claim

invariants: one tool catalog source of truth; transport adapters cannot register tools independently
transport metadata is request context and never caller-controlled authority
tool schema stability; no v0.1 schema change without separate governance
local kernel remains authoritative; stdio behavior remains supported
no new OS authority introduced by transport refactoring

acceptance.claim: One authoritative server builder registers the complete v0.1 tool catalog with byte-compatible schemas and safe result projection.
Stdio transport reuses the authoritative builder with no independent tool authority, and loopback and relay skeletons reuse the same builder and kernel contract.

Transport contract tests prove identical tool surface, schemas, and result projection across in-process builder and stdio transport, and all closed SG-000001 through SG-000047 regressions pass unchanged.
Exact-head CI including release qualification and supply-chain audit, genuine TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, manual review of excluded files, and zero unresolved review threads all pass.

successor_requirements.sg_000049: Supported local stdio entrypoint may proceed only after SG-000048 closes, using the authoritative builder without new authority.

done_when: The transport-neutral MCP server builder is canonical with preserved v0.1 catalog and transport contract tests and no authority change.
